## Change

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and its scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Ruff check and format check pass
- [ ] Relevant integration test passes
- [ ] Migration/config/Compose changes were validated
- [ ] No secrets, raw incident data, or generated security artifacts are included
- [ ] Documentation and `VERSION` are updated when required

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility, data, security, and rollback considerations. Link an issue
when available.
